comparison_rules: match exact product revision, contaminant claim, flow, pressure, source profile and test method
do not compare WHO microbial stars with NSF chemical reduction claims as a single score
separate product certification from local regulatory approval and field service
include end-of-life and post-capacity performance, not only run-in results
compare delivered profile-conforming water and lifecycle burden, not raw removal percentage alone
WHO listed examples are internal scientific references only, not for commercial or promotional reuse
